name: Rebellious Bull: enters the field rested (Pride 3)
notes: Rebellious Bull is NORM, no lineage patch needed. Confirms the printed 'CARDNAME enters the field rested' clause directly via Status (1, rested) after a normal FSM materialize -- the default for a newly-materialized ally is awake (2). Pride 3 (a combat-only restriction, same mechanic already covered generically in gray-wolf-pride-2-attack-rejected) is not separately re-tested here.

rulesClauses: Pride 3 (This ally won't obey you unless your champion is level 3 or higher.)
